mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS change and SPX returns is not statistically significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative monetary policy, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% for two consecutive months, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a weakening consumer demand, which typically triggers monetary policy easing and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (HOUST and RSAFS both declining) fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient and is statistically significant (p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 99.0, it signals an economic contraction that typically leads to aggressive monetary policy support, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 99.0, or the return in such periods is not significantly higher than the average (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) indicates persistent inflation, which typically leads to delayed monetary tightening and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in future rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises, or the correlation between CPIAUCSL change and SPX returns is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 900,000 units per month, it signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 900.0, or the average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market that typically leads to higher inflation expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in future rate hikes.
failure_condition: The interaction effect (PAYEMS up and UNRATE down) fails to produce positive returns in more than 55% of cases over 60 days, or the interaction term in a regression model has a negative coefficient and is statistically significant (p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the quarterly GDP level falls below 15,500 billion dollars, it indicates a slowdown in economic growth that typically prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative policy, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 15500.0, or the return in such periods is not significantly higher than the average (t-test p>0.05).
